newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm as sellers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm as sellers sidelined.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange eased to 465 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 750 kilos with prices firming slightly on weak supply, despite falling world price trends.
Gold closed at $355.00 an ounce from $354.00 on Wednesday, and 1,279,900 lira per gram, versus the previous 1,277,300.
Dealers said sellers kept to the sidelines to await price developments in world markets, causing prices to rise on the local gold bourse.
They added that a firmer lira also discouraged selling. The lira firmed to 112,260 to the dollar from 112,400 at Wednesday's close.
Of the 465 kilos traded, 61.3 percent was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
